original_test_intent: Verify approved Advanced Power Management settings persist and restore to SPEC while power limits, frequency/idle behavior, fan/thermal protection and boot stability remain within the platform envelope.
original_method: Record BIOS/CPU/BMC firmware, power/thermal baseline and exact defaults; preserve logs; approve a reversible control matrix with expected power/performance effect and dependencies; use KVM to change one control/group, save/reboot, verify retention and collect idle/load frequency, power, temperature, throttling, fan and error evidence; Load Defaults and repeat; stop on protection disablement, excursion, throttling anomaly, instability or no-boot and recover through owner-controlled known-good/CMOS procedure.
manual_activity: A qualified operator applies only approved APM values through KVM, performs controlled reboot/default cycles and maintains an independent observer plus physical recovery.
required_inputs: CPU/board/BIOS/BMC/power/cooling identity and calibrated sensor map
APM SPEC defaults and safe values with dependencies and expected power/performance effects
Idle/load power, frequency, thermal, throttling, fan, error and boot acceptance
Maintenance, workload isolation, KVM, hard aborts and recovery ownership
safety_requirements: Never use all/random power settings or disable thermal/current/voltage protections
Preserve BMC/SEL/kernel/thermal telemetry and use timestamped baselines
Change one approved control/group and monitor independent power/thermal evidence before proceeding
Stop on limit excursion, missing protection, unstable rails/fans, unexpected throttle, hang or no-boot
No automated reboot/retry or CMOS clear
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity, defaults/matrix, expected effects, telemetry, maintenance and recovery
Guide operator checkpoints and organize screenshots plus idle/load power/frequency/thermal/fan/error evidence
Compare retained/restored states without issuing verdict
Do not select values, clear logs, alter protections, navigate BIOS autonomously or invoke recovery
engineer_actions: Approve APM defaults and reversible matrix with protection/dependency constraints
Approve workload, telemetry cadence, limits, reboot criteria and recovery
Review page, power/thermal/performance and log evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

Per-phase power, frequency/idle, temperature, throttle and fan evidence under approved conditions

review_improvement: Adds effective power/thermal behavior and protection evidence, preventing retained menu text from concealing unsafe power policy or cooling response.
independent_technical_reasoning: Advanced power controls affect the live safety envelope, not only configuration persistence. A system can boot while limits, idle states, fan response or throttling are wrong. Each approved change therefore needs an expected-effect oracle and independent telemetry, with protection settings never randomized. Manual KVM and physical recovery remain required because an unsafe policy can destabilize the platform before remote access returns.
